title: Queenstown Walks & Hikes | Official Queenstown Website
facts: The official walking guide lists Queenstown Hill, Ben Lomond, Bob’s Cove, Glenorchy Lagoon and Arrowtown trails.
It distinguishes lower-level walks from alpine routes where snow and ice can require additional equipment and experience.
Visitors are advised to check DOC track conditions and MetService forecasts before walks.
confidence: official-source; editorial review limited to listed stable facts
notes: Stable place and visitor-planning facts only. Prices, opening hours, event schedules and safety guarantees are deliberately omitted; consult operators for current conditions.
